headword: {飛|と}んで{火|ひ}に{入|い}る{夏|なつ}の{虫|むし}
reading: とんでひにいるなつのむし
gloss: walking right into danger; asking for trouble

definitions.gloss: walking right into danger; a moth to the flame
definitions.explanation: A proverb: like a summer insect that flies into a fire, someone who walks of their own accord into danger or ruin. Often said, with a sneer, of an enemy or rival who comes straight to where one is waiting.

examples.japanese: ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{飛|と}んで{火|ひ}に{入|い}る{夏|なつ}の{虫|むし}だ。

⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盗|ぬす}み→盗み：19789_nusumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{飛|と}んで{火|ひ}に{入|い}る{夏|なつ}の{虫|むし}だ。
examples.english: Stealing right in front of the police is asking for trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本拠地|ほんきょち}→本拠地：13088_honkyochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗|の}り{込|こ}む→乗り込む：04618_norikomu⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{飛|と}んで{火|ひ}に{入|い}る{夏|なつ}の{虫|むし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ようなものだ。
examples.english: Going alone into the enemy's stronghold is like a moth flying into the flame.

notes:
Literally "the summer insect that flies into the fire": on summer nights, moths and other insects drawn to lamps and bonfires burn themselves. It is used both as a warning and, in dramas and manga, as a villain's taunt when the hero arrives: {飛|と}んで{火|ひ}に{入|い}る{夏|なつ}の{虫|むし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{前|まえ}→お前：02533_omae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ.

USAGE:
It describes the person, so it is said of someone, usually not of oneself, and often follows ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ or ⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧, as in the examples.
